packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor/patch/digest updates once CI passes - this repo's branch protection already requires a green CI run to merge (see CONTRIBUTING.md), so Renovate is only adding the 'wait for checks, then merge' step on top of that existing gate. Major updates always need a human look, given they can carry breaking changes.
Major updates are never auto-merged, regardless of manager - always left for manual review.

frontend/'s dependencies (React, Vite, Tailwind, TanStack Query, Zustand, Playwright's own @playwright/test in e2e/tests/, ...) grouped into one PR per update type, rather than one PR per package - this app has no monorepo tooling, so each individual bump would otherwise be its own noisy PR.
e2e/tests/ is a deliberately separate npm project from frontend/ (see e2e/README.md) - kept in its own group so a Playwright bump there doesn't get bundled with unrelated frontend dependency noise.
Go module dependencies (backend/go.mod) grouped into one PR per update type.

GitHub Actions used across .github/workflows/ - pinned to major-version tags today (e.g. actions/checkout@v7), so most updates here are 'major' by Renovate's own versioning judgment even for routine bumps; pinDigests additionally tracks the exact commit each tag points to, so a same-tag security fix upstream still produces an auto-mergeable 'digest' update rather than nothing at all.
Base images in deploy/Dockerfile and deploy/mock-vyos.Dockerfile (node, golang, gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12) grouped into one PR per update type.

The real-VyOS e2e suite's pinned rolling/Stream builds (e2e/vyos-versions.env) never auto-merge, regardless of update type - unlike this repo's other dependencies, e2e.yml only runs on a schedule/tag-push/workflow_dispatch, not on every PR (see e2e/README.md), so a PR bumping one of these has no automated confirmation that the new pinned build actually boots and passes the suite before merge. A human should either run e2e.yml manually against the bumped version first, or accept the (bounded, next-Monday) delay before the scheduled run surfaces a problem.

VyOS Stream's tag format has changed over the channel's own history (older releases: '1.5-stream-YYYY-QN'; current: 'YYYY.MM') - 'loose' versioning compares these as dot/hyphen-separated segments, which happens to still sort every real release chronologically today (numeric year always outranks the old '1.5' prefix), but re-verify this against https://vyos.net/get/stream/ if VyOS ever changes the format again and a bump looks wrong.

customManagers.description: Tracks e2e/vyos-versions.env's pinned rolling-release tag against vyos/vyos-nightly-build's real GitHub Releases feed - always kept at the actual latest rolling build.

Tracks e2e/vyos-versions.env's pinned newest-Stream-release tag (VYOS_STREAM_0_TAG only - the other 3 Stream slots are manually curated, see that file's own doc comment) against a custom HTML-scrape datasource, since VyOS Stream has no structured release feed/API at all.
